title: John Lennon watches Richie Havens perform in Los Angeles | 1973
content:
John Lennon and May Pang watched Richie Havens perform at the Roxy Theatre in Los Angeles, USA, on 24 September 1973.

Located on the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood, the Roxy had opened the previous week. Lennon and Pang had watched Neil Young and the Santa Monica Flyers play there two days previously.
